summary: London BC pilot (RECIPE-BC-LONDON-PILOT-V1, Jai BC) verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 9/9 pass: pilot + V1 recipes both ACTIVE with imposition_template='Jai BC' and 'London BC' respectively; quickstart PILOT_3_25x2_25 (3.25x2.25 PDF, Glossy) held=true at PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED with fiery_state=HELD_VERIFIED, imposition_template='Jai BC', properties={size:'3.25×2.25 (bleed)', stock:'Glossy', impose_preset:'Jai BC'}; quickstart STD_3_5x2 (3.75x2.25 PDF, Matte) held=true with size='3.5×2 (no-bleed)'; wrong 7x4 geometry stops with WRONG_DIMENSIONS (held=false); invalid size_option -> 400; invalid stock -> 400; non-PDF -> 400; AI actor authorize -> 403; human authorize -> PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED terminal; further advance -> 400 (PRINT locked); legacy /api/production/jobs with RECIPE-BC-LONDON-V1 still uses 'London BC'. Frontend: OrderDialog on /orders (New Order) shows pilot-block with pilot-size (exactly 2 options: '3.5×2 (no-bleed)', '3.25×2.25 (bleed)'), pilot-stock-matte/glossy, pilot-dropzone, pilot-file-input. Setting a 3.25x2.25 PDF via input auto-calls /production/jobs/quickstart, shows toast 'Job BC-1236 imposed (Jai BC) — held for your approval', closes dialog and navigates to /production; prod-job-properties displays 'Size: 3.25×2.25 (bleed)  Stock: Glossy  Impose: Jai BC' and prod-current-state=PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED. EDIT dialog (Edit Order #58311) does NOT render pilot-block. Human auth gate never bypassed — no printing.
critical_code_review_comments: production.py: quickstart safely rejects unsupported size_option/stock and empty/non-PDF payload with 400; PDF >50MB blocked. Good.
OrderDialog.startPilot: on network/parse failure it toasts detail from server. Good. Consider surfacing stop.code as a distinct UI hint (e.g., 'Wrong dimensions') in addition to the technical code.
Engine.advance at PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED raises 400 which is fine but the message text 'PRINT is locked in V0.2' — okay for a preview build.
Auth gate: AI actor path is denied in both policy() and authorize() route (defense-in-depth).
production.py is >1200 lines — consider splitting engine / adapter / router into separate modules for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Created ~3 throwaway prod_jobs (BC-1236 etc.) via quickstart during tests + 1 legacy job via /api/production/jobs. One job authorized to terminal PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED (locked, no print). No orders created — pilot flow bypasses /api/orders.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pilot recipe is ACTIVE and used by the New Order pilot dropzone; legacy production.jobs POST still defaults to RECIPE-BC-LONDON-V1 with 'London BC'. Do not authorize additional jobs during retests — one throwaway is enough. Test PDFs can be generated via backend.production.make_pdf_bytes(w,h,pages,with_bleed).
